# `/ui-plugins` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /ui-plugins/v1

`listUiPluginsV1` — List plugin instances — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns plugin instances for the caller's tenant with optional V3-style pagination. When `count=true`, the response includes header `x-total-count`. Requires product license `idn:ui-plugins` or `idn:ui-plugins-author` (404 if neither is present). Returns 400 `User context is invalid` when the caller has no tenant id. Results include only that tenant's plugin instances.

- Scopes: idn:plugins-ui:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
- Returns 200: array of uiplugin

### POST /ui-plugins/v1

`createUiPluginV1` — Create a plugin instance — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Registers a new tenant-scoped plugin installation. Enforces: - Max **20** plugin instances per tenant - Slot registry rules (`slotId` must exist; per-slot `maxPlugins`; no duplicate slotIds) - Alias uniqueness within the tenant (normalized lowercase) - CSP / Permissions-Policy / iframe-allow / iframe-sandbox allowlists - Product license `idn:ui-plugins-author` (404 if missing) - Caller tenant id is present (400 `User context is invalid` otherwise). The instance is created in that tenant. Emits…

- Scopes: idn:plugins-ui:create
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): createuipluginrequest
- Returns 201: createuipluginresponse

### GET /ui-plugins/v1/validate-alias

`testUiPluginAliasV1` — Test plugin alias availability — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Checks whether the given alias is available within the caller's tenant. Alias is normalized (trim + lowercase) server-side. Success returns an empty body (HTTP 200). Conflict when the alias is taken. UUID-shaped aliases are rejected as invalid. Requires product license `idn:ui-plugins` or `idn:ui-plugins-author` (404 if neither is present). Returns 400 `User context is invalid` when the caller has no tenant id. The alias is evaluated only within that tenant.

- Scopes: idn:plugins-ui:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `alias` (query, required) — Alias to validate (3-63 chars; letters, numbers, dashes; no leading/trailing/consecutive dashes)
- Returns 200: no body

### GET /ui-plugins/v1/resolve-alias

`getUiPluginByAliasV1` — Get plugin by alias — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Resolves a tenant-scoped alias to its `UiPlugin`. Returns 404 if no match; 409 if the alias is ambiguous (more than one match; should not occur after uniqueness enforcement). Requires product license `idn:ui-plugins` or `idn:ui-plugins-author` (404 if neither is present). Returns 400 `User context is invalid` when the caller has no tenant id. The alias is resolved only within that tenant; no match is 404.

- Scopes: idn:plugins-ui:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `alias` (query, required) — Alias to resolve within the caller's tenant
- Returns 200: uiplugin

### GET /ui-plugins/v1/{pluginInstanceId}

`getUiPluginV1` — Get a plugin instance — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns a plugin instance by ID for the caller's tenant. Requires product license `idn:ui-plugins` or `idn:ui-plugins-author` (404 if neither is present). Returns 400 `User context is invalid` when the caller has no tenant id. The instance is loaded only when it belongs to that tenant; a mismatch is 404.

- Scopes: idn:plugins-ui:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `pluginInstanceId` (path, required) — UUID of the plugin instance
- Returns 200: uiplugin

### PATCH /ui-plugins/v1/{pluginInstanceId}

`updateUiPluginV1` — Partially update a plugin instance — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Patch any subset of mutable fields. When `slots` is provided, replaces the entire slots list and re-validates registry / maxPlugins rules. When `apiScopes` is provided, replaces the entire scopes list. When `iframeSandbox` is provided, replaces the entire sandbox grant list; unlike CSP / Permissions-Policy changes, it does not rotate the active asset bundle. `state` may be set to `ENABLED` or `DISABLED` (DISABLED omits the instance from active-slots delivery). Requires product license…

- Scopes: idn:plugins-ui:update
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `pluginInstanceId` (path, required) — UUID of the plugin instance
- Body (application/json): updateuipluginrequest
- Returns 200: uiplugin

### DELETE /ui-plugins/v1/{pluginInstanceId}

`deleteUiPluginV1` — Delete a plugin instance — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Deletes the plugin instance and associated resources (asset bundles tombstoned for deferred cleanup). Requires product license `idn:ui-plugins` or `idn:ui-plugins-author` (404 if neither is present). Returns 400 `User context is invalid` when the caller has no tenant id. The instance is deleted only when it belongs to that tenant; a mismatch is 404. Emits Kafka audit event `UI_PLUGIN_INSTANCE_DELETED` on success.

- Scopes: idn:plugins-ui:delete
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `pluginInstanceId` (path, required) — UUID of the plugin instance
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /ui-plugins/v1/{pluginInstanceId}/link

`createUiPluginLinkV1` — Create a plugin dev link — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Registers the caller's identity against a local HTTPS origin `https://localhost:{port}` in the instance's `devOverrides` map. Used by the `sail ui-plugins link` CLI flow. Requires product license `idn:ui-plugins-author` (404 if missing). Returns 400 `User context is invalid` when the caller has no tenant id or identity id. That identity id is the key in `devOverrides`, so the caller can only set their own local-dev URL. A plugin instance in another tenant is 404. Response body contains the…

- Scopes: idn:plugins-ui:update
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `pluginInstanceId` (path, required) — UUID of the plugin instance
- Body (application/json): linkuipluginrequest
- Returns 201: linkuipluginresponse

### DELETE /ui-plugins/v1/{pluginInstanceId}/link

`deleteUiPluginLinkV1` — Delete a plugin dev link — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Removes only the current caller's `identityId` entry from `devOverrides`. Other developers' overrides are preserved. Requires product license `idn:ui-plugins-author` (404 if missing). Returns 400 `User context is invalid` when the caller has no tenant id or identity id. A plugin instance in another tenant is 404.

- Scopes: idn:plugins-ui:update
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `pluginInstanceId` (path, required) — UUID of the plugin instance
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /ui-plugins/v1/{pluginInstanceId}/asset-bundles

`createUiPluginAssetBundleV1` — Create a plugin asset bundle — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Accepts `multipart/form-data` with one or more parts named **`file`**. The bundle-relative path for each object is taken from the part's multipart **filename** (`originalname`). Paths are normalized (no `..`, no absolute paths) and stored under `{pluginInstanceId}/{assetBundleId}/...` in S3. Folder structure is preserved, not flattened. Requirements: - Bundle must include root `index.html` - Configurable limits on file count, per-file bytes, and total bundle bytes - Product license…

- Scopes: idn:plugins-ui:update
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `pluginInstanceId` (path, required) — UUID of the plugin instance
- Body (multipart/form-data): object
- Returns 201: uipluginassetbundle
